name: A cold load of #/jfbm-demo-a with Bookmarks' ClientScript held back 1.5 s (webcheck delayRequests) shows no "Page not found" frame and the right title from the head fragment, then the same with the pre-hide rule outranked (positive control, flash frames > 0). Needs EnablePageDemo on (it turns it on).

steps.name: turn the page demo on (the developer setting EnablePageDemo; per request)
steps.script: const id = 'd0ee1b2a-7f71-4654-8ff2-163a81441b03'; const c = await ApiClient.getPluginConfiguration(id); Object.assign(c, {"EnablePageDemo":true,"EnableDemoPageB":true,"EnableWebUi":true}); await ApiClient.updatePluginConfiguration(id, c); const r = await ApiClient.getPluginConfiguration(id); return { EnablePageDemo: r.EnablePageDemo, EnableDemoPageB: r.EnableDemoPageB, EnableWebUi: r.EnableWebUi, PageHostMode: r.PageHostMode };

steps.name: reload, so index.html carries the demo's head fragment
baseline: Demo page A
